title: Flamingos at a Florida Zoo Rode Out Hurricane Isaias in the Bathroom
summary: ZooWorld in Panama City Beach, Fla. squeezed a group of 30 flamingos into a bathroom to shelter them from Hurricane Isaias, which hit the Gulf Coast.
